# Crestward Labs

> Agentic AI systems and software engineering practice based in Vancouver, BC, Canada.

Crestward Labs designs, builds, and ships production-grade agentic AI systems and full-stack software products for founders, product teams, and CTOs. Every engagement is led hands-on by senior engineers — no layers of management.

## Services

- **Agentic AI Systems**: Multi-agent architectures that reason, plan, and act autonomously. Built with RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol), real-time SSE streaming, and public APIs. Compatible with Claude, GPT-4o, and open-weight models.
- **Software Engineering**: Full-stack product development with clean architecture. Production-grade APIs and frontends using FastAPI, TypeScript, Angular, and PostgreSQL.
- **AI Workflow Automation**: End-to-end automation using all orchestration modes: sequential pipelines, parallel fan-out, hierarchical delegation, event-driven triggers, collaborative peer agents, and hybrid combinations.

## Orchestration Modes

Crestward Labs has expertise in every major multi-agent workflow pattern:

- **Sequential**: Step-by-step pipelines where each agent hands off to the next.
- **Parallel**: Simultaneous fan-out execution across multiple agents for maximum throughput.
- **Hierarchical**: An orchestrator delegates to sub-agents, each managing their own scope.
- **Event-Driven**: Agents activate on webhooks, schedules, database events, or API calls.
- **Collaborative**: Agents communicate directly as peers, sharing context and negotiating outputs.
- **Hybrid**: Any combination of the above patterns within a single workflow.

## FlowStudio

FlowStudio (https://flowstudio-ai.com) is Crestward Labs' own agent workflow builder, currently in early access. Agents, tools, and workflows come together on a single canvas — from a simple automation to a full agent team. Supports all six workflow modes, one canvas, and bring-your-own model keys.

## Technology Stack

Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Angular, PostgreSQL, Azure, Claude API (Anthropic), OpenAI API, RAG pipelines, MCP (Model Context Protocol), SSE streaming, multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
